title: Decode
description: The full result for one VIN, as every nitrovin surface emits it (HTTP, stdio, CLI JSON, C ABI). The root is a Decode; $defs holds the other wire types. Contract prose: docs/api/README.md.

vin.description: The VIN as decoded: the request's vin trimmed, uppercased, with every non-ASCII character replaced by '&'.

wmi.description: Positions 1-3, plus 12-14 when position 3 is '9' and the VIN has at least 14 characters.

model_year.description: The model year the winning pass decoded (element 29); null when none was resolved.

error_codes.description: vPIC's error codes (element 143), ascending. [0] is a clean decode.

check_digit_valid.description: True when the VIN has at least 17 characters and position 9 equals the computed check digit. A vPIC VinException suppresses error code 1 but leaves this false.

corrected_vin.description: vPIC's suggested VIN (element 142, '!' at positions in error); null when that element is empty.

model_year_hint.description: The request's model_year, echoed; null when none was given.

now.description: The clock this decode used, in UTC whole seconds: the request's now, or the wall clock read once per request.

data_month.description: The data month of the loaded artifact.

decoder_version.description: The nitrovin module version that decoded, e.g. 'v1.2.0'; '(devel)' for an untagged build.

shape.description: The layout of attributes, as requested (default 'vpic').

attributes.description: The decoded vehicle, laid out per shape.

items.description: Present only when the request set full: every item the decoder emitted, in item order (docs/api/README.md).

VpicAttributes.description: vPIC's DecodeVinValues layout. One key per public element of the data month, named by its element code, always present ('' when undecoded), plus MakeID, ManufacturerId and ModelID. A multi-valued element's distinct values are joined with ', ' in byte order.

NitrovinAttributes.description: Keyed by variable name; only decoded elements are present. A multi-valued element always carries values, every other element value.

value.description: The oracle's exact text; numbers are never retyped.

attribute_id.description: vPIC's attribute id; present only on lookup elements whose id is an integer (never on Error Code, 143).

values.description: Every attribute of the element, duplicates kept, in byte order.

Item.description: One row of spvindecode's output for this VIN, all 15 columns, SQL NULL as null.

attribute_id.description: itemattributeid as text: a lookup id, a code list ('1,11,400'), or the raw attribute.

created_on.description: itemcreatedon as Postgres renders a timestamp, e.g. '2015-04-21 11:37:26.607'.

vin.description: 1-17 characters after trimming spaces: vPIC's spvindecode holds the trimmed VIN in a varchar(17) and raises on a longer one. Any such string decodes; partial ('*') and mistyped VINs return error codes, not a refusal.

now.description: Frozen clock: an RFC 3339 instant, or a date meaning 00:00:00Z that day. Fractional seconds are truncated. Absent: the wall clock, read once per request.

DecodeRequest.description: One decode request: an element of the POST /v1/decode array, a GET's path and query, a C ABI request.

BatchResponse.description: One decode per request item, same order, same length.

StdioRequest.description: One line of `nitrovin stdio` input, and the request_json of nitrovin_decode: op's request plus an optional id.

id.description: Any JSON value; echoed on the reply.

op.description: The request beside it: a DecodeRequest, a TranslateRequest or a ListRequest. The reply is keyed decode, translation or list.

StdioReply.description: One line of `nitrovin stdio` output, and the return of nitrovin_decode: the request's id when it had one, then its op's answer or an error.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. The type URI is one of the problem types in docs/api/README.md.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the request to the offending value, e.g. '/3/vin' for item 3 of a batch; on GET, '/<query parameter>' or '/vin'.

artifact_hash.description: <algorithm>:<hex> of the loaded artifact's bytes; the algorithm is the artifact format's.

data_source.description: 'embedded', or the absolute path of the artifact loaded with --data, NITROVIN_DATA or nitrovin_open.

elements.description: Every public element of the data month, by element_id.

vocabularies.description: The vocabularies, extension sets and declared spines loaded beside the data (--vocab, NITROVIN_VOCAB), in load order; empty when none are. Decisions: ADR 0011, ADR 0012.

blake3.description: The hex blake3 hash of the file's bytes.

path.description: The absolute path the file was loaded from.

drift.description: The file's drift against the data month, by kind, only the kinds it has, in the order make, model, qualifier, extension, model-years; empty when it agrees with the month. Drift is served, never refused.

kind.description: make, model: a vPIC id the month lacks. qualifier: an element the month lacks, a value of the wrong type for it, or a value its decode never produces. extension: an extension named like a vPIC make, or a vPIC model under the same make. model-years: a mapping's first–last partly or wholly outside its vPIC model's model years.

examples.description: The first findings of the kind, in line order.

TranslateRequestFields.description: A translate request's fields (ADR 0012): from a VIN, a vocabulary entry or a spine entry, through exactly one spine, to the target vocabularies. Contract prose: docs/api/README.md, Translation.

oneOf.description: A VIN, 1-17 characters after trimming spaces, as a decode request's vin.

to.description: Target vocabulary names, each a loaded vocabulary on the same spine as from. Absent or empty: the spine alone.

model_year.description: The model year: the VIN's decode hint, and the year when no VIN decodes one. A VIN's decoded year wins over it.

vin.description: A context VIN when from is an entry: its decode checks qualifiers and gives the model year. Refused beside a VIN from.

now.description: Frozen clock for the VIN's decode, as a decode request's now.

TranslateRequest.description: One translate request, the same object on every surface (ADR 0012); on stdio, a line with op translate.

VocabularyEntryRef.description: An entry of a loaded vocabulary, by its fields: exactly the vocabulary's fields, matched after trimming, collapsing whitespace and Unicode lower-casing.

SpineRefFields.description: One spine entry as a mapping target names it: exactly one of a vPIC make id, a vPIC model id, an extension, or a declared spine's name with one of its ids.

spine.description: A declared spine's name, beside id.

id.description: An entry id of the declared spine.

Translation.description: The answer to a TranslateRequest: the route from from through the spine to each target vocabulary. Nothing to translate is never a refusal: an unknown or unmapped entry, or a target with no entries, answers with a status and empty lists.

spine.description: Every spine entry reached, once each, in route order: each mapping's spine entry, then the make a vPIC or extension model sits under; for a VIN, its model then its make.

to.description: One per target vocabulary, in request order, each named once.

vocabularies.description: The files the translation used, in load order.

now.description: The clock the VIN's decode used (resolved when there is no VIN), in UTC whole seconds.

TranslationFrom.description: The request's from with its status: the VIN as decoded; the entry as its vocabulary writes it (as the request did when unknown) with the entry's note; or the spine entry.

status.description: mapped: the entry has mappings, or the VIN or spine entry reaches the spine. unmapped: the vocabulary lists the entry without mappings. unknown: the vocabulary or spine has no such entry, or the VIN decodes to no vPIC make or model.

Vehicle.description: What a translation reads from a VIN's decode, from or context: never the whole decode.

make.description: The decoded vPIC make id (element 26's attribute id).

model.description: The decoded vPIC model id (element 28's attribute id).

SpineEntry.description: One spine entry in an answer, named from the data month or its file.

name.description: Absent for a declared-spine entry its file leaves unnamed, and with drift.

drift.description: A vPIC id the data month lacks, named by a mapping and served anyway (ADR 0011).

under.description: The make a vPIC or extension model sits under.

years.description: In a list of vpic, a model's model years: the year bands of every VIN schema with a Model pattern naming it, merged into ranges, ascending, gaps kept (ADR 0022). Absent when unknown: no VIN schema with a Model pattern naming it has a year band.

via.description: In a translation from a vocabulary entry: the entry's mappings that reached this spine entry. A make reached because a model sits under it has the model's mapping.

YearRange.description: A run of model years, inclusive. No last: still running.

Via.description: One mapping that held on a route: the spine entry it names, its years, origin and note as its file has them, and what could not be checked on the route through it.

Unconfirmed.description: What applied but could not be checked: qualifier element ids, ascending, with no decode or that the decode left empty, then "model_year" when a year range applied and no year was known. Absent when everything was checked.

entries.description: Each entry reached once, in list order (by normalized fields).

via.description: Every mapping of the entry that held, each naming the spine entry that led to it, in spine order.

unconfirmed.description: Absent when one via checked everything, so a client can keep only fully confirmed entries.

ListRequestFields.description: A list request's fields (ADR 0012). Without of: the catalog of what is loaded. With of: one page of vPIC ('vpic') or a loaded file. Contract prose: docs/api/README.md, Listing.

where.description: Fields to match after the fixed normalization: a vocabulary's fields; for vpic, make, a vPIC make id, to list its models, and with make year, one model year, keeping the models whose years include it or are unknown (ADR 0022); or model and element together, a vPIC model id and a public element id, to list the model's values for the element (ADR 0015). Model or element alone, or either with make or year, is refused.

ListRequest.description: One list request, the same object on every surface (ADR 0012); on stdio, a line with op list.

List.description: The answer to a ListRequest: the catalog, or one page of what of names.

entries.description: CatalogEntry for the catalog; VocabularyEntry for a vocabulary; ModelValueEntry for vpic with where.model and where.element; SpineEntry for the rest of vpic, a declared spine or an extension set.

next.description: The after of the next page; absent on the last.

vocabularies.description: The files listed: every loaded file for the catalog, the one of names, none for vpic.

ModelValueEntry.description: One value a VIN of the vPIC model can decode the element to (ADR 0015). The list may hold a value no VIN of the model ends up with, but never leaves one out. Text values come by normalized then exact value, attribute ids ascending.

value.description: The attribute id for a lookup element; the exact text for a text element.

name.description: The attribute's name, for a lookup element only.

version.description: A file's version; vpic's is the data month.

spine.description: The spine a vocabulary or extension set routes through: vpic, or a declared spine's name.

VocabularyEntry.description: One vocabulary entry as its file has it.

VocabularyMapping.description: One mapping as its file has it: vocabulary.schema.json's Mapping.
